steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mg/mL stock solutions of Trimethylamine (TMA), Trimethylamine N-Oxide (TMAO), Choline Chloride, and L-Carnitine hydrochloride in water.

steps.title: Prepare Mixed Stock and Serial Dilutions
steps.instruction: Create a series of mixed stock solutions through sequential 1:10 dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µg/mL mixed stock by adding 50 µL of each 1 mg/mL stock solution (TMA, TMAO, Choline Chloride, and L-Carnitine hydrochloride) to 800 µL of water.
Dilute 100 µL of the 50 µg/mL stock with 900 µL water to obtain a 5 µg/mL stock.
Dilute 100 µL of the 5 µg/mL stock with 900 µL water to obtain a 500 ng/mL stock.
Dilute 100 µL of the 500 ng/mL stock with 900 µL water to obtain a 50 ng/mL stock.
Dilute 100 µL of the 50 ng/mL stock with 900 µL water to obtain a 5 ng/mL stock.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standard
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 µg/mL solution of isotopically labelled internal standard (13C3-Thiamine) in water by adding 40 µL of 100 µg/mL 13C3-Thiamine to 1960 µL of water.

steps.title: Prepare Calibration Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare calibration standards according to the specifications in Table S3.

steps.title: Prepare Plate Map and Hardware
steps.instruction: Organize the sample layout and prepare the collection hardware.

substeps.instruction: Label a Biotage 2 mL deep well 96-well ISOLUTE filter plate with batch details.
Label a Waters 2 mL deep well 96-well collection plate.
Generate a 96-well format plate map for standards and samples using a column-wise design as per Table S2.

steps.title: Process Biological Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare plasma or urine samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Remove biological samples from the freezer and defrost at room temperature.
Vortex samples thoroughly and centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Aliquot Samples and Standards
steps.instruction: Distribute samples and standards into glass vials.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and label up to 96 glass vials (1.75 mL) in an 8 x 12 vial rack matching the plate map orientation.
Add 20 µL of biological sample (urine or plasma) or 20 µL of water (for standards) to the vials using a Gilson Repetman pipette.
Add the appropriate volume and concentration of standard solutions to the 20 µL water for standards using 20 µL and 200 µL pipettes (refer to Table S3).

steps.title: Perform Derivatization
steps.instruction: Derivatize the trimethylamine compounds in the vials.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of 2 µg/mL 13C3-Thiamine internal standard to all standards and samples (excluding double blanks) using a Gilson Repetman pipette.
Cap the vials and mix thoroughly by vortex.
Add 50 µL of 20 mg/mL tert-Butyl Bromoacetate (tBBA) in acetonitrile to all vials using a Gilson Repetman pipette.
Add 10 µL of 2.5% Ammonia solution to all vials.
Incubate the mixture for 30 minutes at room temperature to create the trimethylamine derivative (TMA-tBBA).
Add 100 µL of 0.5% formic acid in acetonitrile using a Gilson Repetman pipette to quench the reaction.

steps.title: Filter and Transfer Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer the processed samples from vials to the LC-MS/MS collection plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer standards and samples directly into a Biotage 2 mL deep well 96-well ISOLUTE filter+ plate (placed on top of a Waters 2 mL deep well 96-well collection plate) using an Integra Voyager 300 µL adjustable tip spacing pipette.
Use positive pressure to elute and filter the contents from the ISOLUTE filter plate into the Waters collection plate.
Seal the Waters 2 mL deep well 96-well collection plate using a Waters Adhesive plate seal.

steps.title: Configure LC-MS/MS System
steps.instruction: Set up the chromatography and mass spectrometry parameters.

substeps.instruction: Fit the Waters Acquity UPLC I-Class with an Acquity Premier BEH Amide 1.7 µm, Van Guard FIT, 2.1 mm x 100 mm column.
Set mobile phase A (water with 15 mM ammonium formate) and mobile phase B (acetonitrile) at 0.5 mL/min and 60 °C.
Configure the waste valve to divert to the mass spectrometer at 0.2 mins and back to waste at 5.8 mins.
Set the chromatographic gradient (Table S4) with a run time of 00:06:00 per sample.
Set the Sciex QTRAP 6500+ mass spectrometer to positive mode electrospray ionization (ESI) using Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM) as per Table S5, with flow divert set at 0.2 and 5.5 minutes.
Configure the MS to monitor MRM transitions for each analyte and internal standard as per Table S6.

steps.title: Analyze Samples
steps.instruction: Run the samples and verify results.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sealed collection plate into the autosampler or store at -20 °C.
Inject a mid-level standard to verify chromatography, retention times, and peak area response.
Verify expected retention times: TMA-TBBA (1.1 min), TMAO (2.2 min), Choline (1.6 min), L-Carnitine (2.1 min), and 13C3-Thiamine (2.00 min).
Inject 2 µL per sample for the full batch.
Assess peak areas of chromatograms for analytes and internal standards using parameters from Table S7.
